description: Source code for the AudioProfile class and related functions in the Android media framework, handling audio profile configurations including formats, channels, sample rates, and serialization.

classes.name: AudioProfile
classes.description: Represents an audio profile with format, channels, sample rates, and serialization capabilities.

classes.name: AudioProfileVector
classes.description: A collection of AudioProfile objects with utility functions for managing multiple profiles.

methods.name: createFullDynamic
methods.description: Creates a dynamic AudioProfile with all dynamic flags set.

methods.name: setChannels
methods.description: Sets channel masks if dynamic.

methods.name: setSampleRates
methods.description: Sets sample rates if dynamic.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears dynamic channel and rate data.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of the profile.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another profile, optionally ignoring dynamic flags.

methods.name: toParcelable
methods.description: Converts to a parcelable representation.

methods.name: fromParcelable
methods.description: Creates a profile from a parcelable.

methods.name: toCommonParcelable
methods.description: Converts to a common parcelable format.

methods.name: fromCommonParcelable
methods.description: Creates a profile from a common parcelable format.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a profile to the vector.

methods.name: clearProfiles
methods.description: Clears or resets profiles in the vector.

methods.name: getFirstValidProfile
methods.description: Returns the first valid profile.

methods.name: getFirstValidProfileFor
methods.description: Returns the first valid profile matching a format.

methods.name: getSupportedFormats
methods.description: Returns all supported formats.

methods.name: hasDynamicChannelsFor
methods.description: Checks if dynamic channels exist for a format.

methods.name: hasDynamicFormat
methods.description: Checks if any profile has dynamic format.

methods.name: hasDynamicProfile
methods.description: Checks if any profile is dynamic.

methods.name: hasDynamicRateFor
methods.description: Checks if dynamic rate exists for a format.

methods.name: getSampleRatesFor
methods.description: Gets sample rates for a format.

methods.name: getChannelMasksFor
methods.description: Gets channel masks for a format.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a profile exists in the vector.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of the profile vector.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two profile vectors are equal.

methods.name: addAllValidProfiles
methods.description: Adds all valid profiles from another vector.

methods.name: aidl2legacy_AudioProfileVector
methods.description: Converts from AIDL to legacy AudioProfileVector.

methods.name: legacy2aidl_AudioProfileVector
methods.description: Converts from legacy to AIDL AudioProfileVector.

methods.name: intersectAudioProfiles
methods.description: Computes intersection of two AudioProfileVectors.
